I told Dana in a thread on their #north-team message that the latest deadline is **24 September**, not 20 November.

- **Where it comes from:** Ilse first posted 20 November in #north-team. Later on 14 October they corrected it in #north-random, saying they had read the wrong line. I told Dana to ignore the 20 November date, including my own earlier reply in #north-team.
- **Why it was fine to quote:** Dana is a member of #north-random, and so is everyone in #north-team (Dana, Ilse and Marcus), so the correction was already visible to all of them. A deadline is an operational date, not a finance figure.
- **What's still unclear:** 24 September had already passed when Ilse made the correction, and they didn't give a year. I asked Ilse about that at the time and they haven't replied, so I suggested Dana check with Ilse before marking the date as settled in the tracker.
